summary: Supersedes the 2026-11-07 record whose recordedAt (19:30Z) was local time mislabelled as UTC; capture was about 18:30Z. The fresh CLI 0.4.0 publisher (Delivery #1124) passed independent source review and 32+ synthetic controls, yet against the live repository and services it had seven runtime defects found only by live reads: (1) the ordinary ledger App id/key/installation exist only as execution-pair-forward environment values; (2) ADR-0097 coverage needs the exact pinned-script lock step immediately after checkout in every credential-minting job; (3) whole-file pins on a shared publisher workflow break when another route is appended; (4) a 120 s visibility window cannot cover nuget.org validation and signing; (5) GET rulesets/{id} omits the default update parameter and carries viewer metadata; (6) GET releases/tags/{tag} 404s for drafts; (7) dotnet nuget verify --all prints the repository service index only at -v normal. Original run 42399710679 then verified both package sends but its public-load stage failed with a CalledProcessError whose stderr the design never retains; a later local re-execution passed and stale nuget.org version views shortly after a fresh push remain the unproven probable cause. Because the B publisher files are bound into the journal content identity, recovery could change only the checked-in original-forward admission and the maintained runner (which replaced exactly the one forward=null control with exact continuation controls); forward run 42407023181 then completed tag, release, assets and promotion without resending the packages. An A-to-B population control left enabled-only by design also blocked unrelated producer PRs until the route was retired. Practice: exercise each native response and verifier against measured live shapes before the first irreversible send, pre-check finalization dependencies before sending, retain bounded secret-free stderr for effect-adjacent subprocesses, gate route-specific source-population controls on the route being enabled, retire the route promptly, and hold the producer main stable from enabling merge through finalization. This record grants no publication or forward authority.
title: Release-route controls must use measured live shapes; fixtures hid seven publisher defects
